name: Armor
text: Damage is dealt to Armor before health. Each point of Armor blocks one point of damage and is then removed.

name: Buffet
text: This unit can be eaten multiple times.

name: Burnout
text: Counts down every turn. When Burnout runs out, the unit dies.

name: Enchant
text: Other friendly units on the same floor gain a bonus.

name: Endless
text: When this unit dies, return its card to the top of the draw pile.

name: Fragile
text: If this unit loses health, it dies.

name: Fuel
text: Negates the effect of Inert. Loses 1 stack every turn.

name: Inert
text: This unit cannot attack unless it has Fuel.

name: Multistrike
text: Attacks an additional time each turn.

name: Phased
text: Cannot attack. Cannot be damaged or targeted in any way.

name: Quick
text: Attacks before enemy units during combat.

name: Shard
text: Powers Solgard the Martyr's abilities.

name: Shell
text: At end of turn, remove Echo from the floor to remove Shell from the front unit with Shell. When all Shell is removed, the unit will Hatch.

name: Silence
text: Disables Triggered Abilities.

name: Sweep
text: Attacks all enemy units.

name: Trample
text: When attacking, excess damage is applied to the subsequent enemy unit.

name: Action
text: Triggers at the start of this unit's turn.

name: Armored
text: Triggers when Armor is added to this unit.

name: Eaten
text: After the next round of combat, this unit will be eaten by the front unit without an Eaten ability.

name: End of Turn
text: Triggers at end of turn.

name: Etch
text: Triggers when a card is Consumed on this floor.

name: Extinguish
text: Triggers on death.

name: Gorge
text: Triggers when this unit eats a Morsel unit.

name: Harvest
text: Triggers when a unit on this floor dies.

name: Hatch
text: Once all Shell is removed, the unit dies, triggering its Hatch ability. Apply the Egg unit's upgrades and stat changes to the summoned unit.

name: Hunger
text: Triggers when a unit with Eaten is summoned.

name: Incant
text: Triggers when you cast a spell on this floor.

name: Inspire
text: Triggers when you gain Echo on this floor, once per Echo.

name: Rally
text: Triggers when you play a non-Morsel unit card on this floor.

name: Rejuvenate
text: Triggers when healed, even at full health.

name: Resolve
text: Triggers after combat.

name: Revenge
text: Triggers when damaged.

name: Slay
text: Triggers after dealing a killing blow.

name: Strike
text: Triggers when attacking.

name: Summon
text: Triggers when played.

name: Damage Shield
text: Nullify the next source of damage.

name: Lifesteal
text: When a unit with Lifesteal attacks, it restores health equal to the damage dealt.

name: Rage
text: +2 Attack per stack. Decreases every turn.

name: Regen
text: Restores 1 health per stack at the end of turn. Decreases every turn.

name: Soul
text: Modifies the damage of Devourer of Death's Extinguish ability.

name: Spikes
text: When a unit with Spikes is attacked, the attacker takes 1 damage per stack.

name: Stealth
text: Not a target in combat. Loses 1 stack every turn.

name: Dazed
text: As long as a unit is Dazed, it can't attack or use any Action or Resolve abilities.

name: Emberdrain
text: At the start of turn, you lose 1 Ember for every stack of Emberdrain. Decreases every turn.

name: Frostbite
text: Unit takes 1 damage per stack at the end of turn. Decreases every turn.

name: Melee Weakness
text: The next time the unit is attacked, it takes that much damage again for each stack of Melee Weakness.

name: Reap
text: Unit takes 1 damage per stack of Echo after combat ends. Does not decrease.

name: Rooted
text: Prevents the next time a unit would move between floors. Bosses are immune.

name: Sap
text: -2 Attack per stack. Decreases every turn.

name: Spell Weakness
text: The next time the unit is hit by a damage spell, it takes that much damage again for each stack of Spell Weakness.

name: Ascend
text: Move up a floor and to the back of that floor.

name: Descend
text: Move down a floor and to the back of that floor.

name: Reform
text: Return a defeated friendly unit to your hand. Enhance with Burnout 1, +5 Attack, +5 Health, and 0 Ember.

name: Sacrifice
text: Kill a friendly unit (of the required type in order) to play this card.

name: Cultivate
text: Increase the attack and health of the friendly unit with the lowest health by the Cultivate value.

name: Attuned
text: Multiply the effects of Magic Power by 5.

name: Consume
text: Can only be played once per battle.

name: Extract
text: Lose Echo after you play this card. If you cannot, the card cannot be played.

name: Frozen
text: A Frozen card is not discarded at end of turn. Frozen is removed when the card is played.

name: Infused
text: When played, the current floor will gain 1 Echo.

name: Magic Power
text: Increases the amount of damage dealt and health restored by spells.

name: Offering
text: If discarded before the end of your turn, it will instead be played.

name: Permafrost
text: Gain Frozen when drawn.

name: Piercing
text: Damage dealt by this card ignores armor and shield.

name: Purge
text: Once played, this card is removed from your deck for the rest of the run.

name: Pyrebound
text: Can only be played in the Pyre Room and the floor below it.

name: Reserve
text: Triggers if this card remains in hand at the end of turn.

name: Unplayable
text: Card cannot be played.

name: Unpurgeable
text: Card cannot be purged by shops or Unstable Vortexes.

name: Charged Echo
text: A resource of the Wurmkin clan, stored on each floor (symbol Echo). Infused cards add it; Wurmkin spells and abilities use it. Each floor starts with 4 Echo slots; Echo can exceed the slots, but the excess is removed at the end of turn. Some effects add unremovable Echo for the rest of combat.
